title: Macedonia's Generosity and Titus' Mission
description: Paul speaks of the overflowing generosity of the poor churches in Macedonia, who gave beyond their ability out of their own free will. He urges the Corinthians to complete the collection for the saints with the same zeal, and sends Titus along with two brothers to organize the gift. [ref:2 Cor 8:1-5|Macedonia's overflowing gift] [ref:2 Cor 8:6-15|Call to equality and completion] [ref:2 Cor 8:16-24|Sending of Titus and the brothers]
